items.title: Local evolution of the adopted electrovacuum model
items.physical_scope: Conditional local evolution in the selected smooth, source-free, zero-matter-action Einstein-Maxwell branch. It covers the stated periodic high-Sobolev class and arbitrary smooth constrained data locally, subject to magnetic compatibility with one supplied normalized circle-bundle sector; electric initial data remain independent smooth data. There is no uniform noncompact time width, global-time, maximal-development, or empirical-validity claim.

references.title: P. T. Chruściel, An introduction to the Cauchy problem for the Einstein equations, Roscoff lecture notes (2011), complete 132-page notes, §1.6, printed pp. 23–25 (PDF pp. 27–29)
references.locator: The covariant source-free Maxwell two-form, electric/magnetic split, Einstein coupling, Lorenz-gauge Cauchy system and Maxwell constraint propagation. The source uses a global potential and supplies no coupled local existence proof.

references.title: M. Alcubierre, J. C. Degollado and M. Salgado, The Einstein-Maxwell system in 3+1 form and initial data for multiple charged black holes, arXiv:0907.1151v2 (2009), complete 20-page paper
references.locator: §§II.1–II.3, PDF pp. 3–8, Maxwell field-strength evolution, divergence constraints, electromagnetic stress and Einstein constraints. Gaussian normalization and the paper's opposite K sign are not imported; its Einstein evolution discussion explicitly does not prove coupled local existence.

references.title: H. S. Reall, Part III General Relativity, Cambridge lecture notes, 12 October 2022 revision, complete 125-page notes
references.locator: §6.2, equation (6.8), covariant Maxwell equations; §6.3, equations (6.27)–(6.28), electromagnetic stress and its source-free conservation exercise; §10.4, constraints. Gaussian normalization and c=1 conventions are not imported.

items.title: Electromagnetic conservation in source-free curved spacetime
items.physical_scope: A local model deduction for the smooth zero-matter-action Einstein-Maxwell branch on a Lorentzian four-manifold. It asserts covariant conservation of the electromagnetic stress on stationary source-free configurations only; it does not assert existence, global energy conservation, or empirical validity.

references.title: H. S. Reall, Part III General Relativity, Cambridge lecture notes, 12 October 2022 revision, complete 125-page notes
references.locator: §6.2, equation (6.8), curved-spacetime Maxwell equations; §6.3, equations (6.27)–(6.28), electromagnetic stress tensor and its local conservation consequence.

references.title: M. Alcubierre, J. C. Degollado and M. Salgado, The Einstein-Maxwell system in 3+1 form and initial data for multiple charged black holes, arXiv:0907.1151v2 (2009), complete paper
references.locator: §II.1, equations (2.1)–(2.4), covariant Maxwell and dual equations; §II.2, equations (2.70)–(2.78), Maxwell stress tensor and observer projections.

items.title: Maximal smooth Cauchy development of adopted electrovacuum
items.physical_scope: Conditional universal smooth globally hyperbolic development for the zero-matter-action Einstein-Maxwell field-strength model, with initial data in one supplied normalized circle-bundle sector. Maximality is within smooth globally hyperbolic developments; no geodesic completeness, rough or non-globally-hyperbolic extension maximality, global-time estimate, or empirical-validity claim is made.

references.title: J. Sbierski, On the Existence of a Maximal Cauchy Development for the Einstein Equations — a Dezornification, arXiv:1309.7591v3 (2015), Definitions and Theorems 2.6–2.8, printed pp. 10–12, and complete proofs §§3.1–3.3, printed pp. 12–24
references.locator: The source is vacuum-only. Its smooth set-sized gluing and maximality argument is used only through the current mathematical EMG supplier, whose local existence and uniqueness obligations are separately supplied.

references.title: P. T. Chruściel, An introduction to the Cauchy problem for the Einstein equations, Roscoff lecture notes (2011), complete 132-page notes, especially §1.6, printed pp. 23–25 (PDF pp. 27–29)
references.locator: Source-free Einstein-Maxwell Cauchy formulation and distinction between Maxwell constraints and evolution. The notes use a global potential; no such global potential is assumed here.

items.title: Adopted parallel-field initial state
items.physical_scope: An exact smooth-data example in the zero-matter-action Einstein-Maxwell model on a flat three-torus. It supplies compatible expanding initial data with nonzero parallel electric and magnetic fields and invokes only the conditional local-development theorem; it asserts no isotropy at later times or empirical observation.
